login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage backups and archives.
login.passkeyHint: Your device will ask for fingerprint, face or PIN.
login.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys are not available on this connection. They need public mode with an HTTPS domain; until then administrators use the emergency sign-in.
login.microsoftHint: With the Microsoft 365 account of your organisation.

emergency.title: Emergency sign-in
emergency.description: Email and password, confirmed with a code from your authenticator app. If none is set up yet, you set it up right after signing in.

backupCode.label: Recovery code
backupCode.hint: One of the codes you stored when you set up the authenticator app. Each code works once.
backupCode.invalidFormat: Please enter a recovery code like abcde-12345.

twoFactor.title: Second factor
twoFactor.description: An authenticator is registered for this account. Please enter the current code.
twoFactor.backupDescription: Use a recovery code when your phone is not at hand. Afterwards, move the authenticator to your new phone under Sign-in security.

error.invalidTotp: The code is invalid or has expired.
error.invalidBackupCode: This recovery code is not valid or was already used.
error.passkeyFailed: Passkey sign-in failed. Please try again.
error.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
error.passkeyRequired: This account signs in with its passkey. The password is accepted only together with an authenticator app, which this account has not set up.
error.microsoftFailed: Sign-in with Microsoft did not complete. Please try again.
error.microsoftCancelled: The sign-in with Microsoft was cancelled.
error.microsoftNotLinked: An account on {appName} with this email address exists but is not connected to Microsoft. Sign in the way that account was set up, or ask your administrator.
error.microsoftNoEmail: Microsoft did not share an email address for this account, and {appName} needs it to find your access. Ask your administrator.
error.locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a moment.

panel.title: Public demo
panel.description: This is a live demo with a ready-made account and synthetic data. The credentials are already filled in below. Just sign in.

demo.banner: Demo: all data resets every night at 03:00; nothing you do here leaves this server, and no visitor IP address is stored.

authenticatorSetup.title: Set up your authenticator app
authenticatorSetup.lead: You signed in with your emergency password. {appName} accepts it only together with a code from an authenticator app, so set one up now. It takes about a minute.

session.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

confirmIdentity.title: Confirm it is you
confirmIdentity.description: This change decides what software runs on the server, so it needs a sign-in from the last 10 minutes. Confirm with your passkey, or sign in again.
confirmIdentity.passkeyHint: Your device asks for fingerprint, face or PIN. The change is then made right away.
confirmIdentity.signInAgainHint: With your password and authenticator code, or the way you usually sign in. You come back to this page and repeat the change.
